page.overview:
Who is Enzo Firenze?

Enzo Firenze was a messenger of House Atreides.

Enzo Firenze participated in the Liberation of Ix. He served as the messenger boy for Duncan Idaho. He wore the Messenger Tabard, which the Forms of Kanly dictated should protect him from interference, he was killed when a dying Sardaukar dashed his head apart against the ground.

Enzo's brother Ugo told the Prisoner of Enzo's death on the battlefield and stated that it had given him a taste for killing Sardaukar, which he would never satisfy.

Category:Dune Awakening Awakening Awakening Awakening
